title: Classic Carbonara
description: An authentic Italian pasta dish with a silky egg and cheese sauce, crispy guanciale, and freshly cracked black pepper. Simple ingredients, extraordinary taste.

1.title: Prepare the Egg Mixture
1.description: In a bowl, whisk together egg yolks, whole eggs, and most of the grated cheeses (save some for garnish). Season generously with black pepper.
tips: Use freshly grated cheese for best results

2.title: Cook the Guanciale
2.description: Place guanciale in a cold pan and cook over medium heat until the fat renders and the meat becomes crispy, about 8-10 minutes. Remove from heat.
tips: Starting with a cold pan helps render the fat slowly

3.title: Cook the Pasta
3.description: Bring a large pot of heavily salted water to boil. Cook spaghetti until al dente, about 1 minute less than package directions. Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining.
tips: The pasta water is crucial for the sauce

4.title: Combine Everything
4.description: Add hot pasta to the pan with guanciale (off heat). Quickly pour in the egg mixture and toss vigorously, adding pasta water as needed to create a creamy sauce. The residual heat will cook the eggs gently.
tips: Keep tossing to prevent scrambled eggs
Work quickly while pasta is hot

5.title: Serve Immediately
5.description: Plate immediately and top with remaining cheese and a generous amount of freshly cracked black pepper.
tips: Carbonara waits for no one - serve right away!
